principle: The ZIP is the canonical module source for Web and Android; Android renders special workflows with dedicated environments but uses the same table and field contract.

zip_contract.rule: panel membership, module ids, tables and business fields are sourced from the ZIP; Android special screens only change presentation/workflow.

canonical_rule: Every visible Android/Web module is sourced from the ZIP contract; special modules keep the same canonical table/field semantics.
notes: This catalog is the single Android/Web module contract. Do not add an Android-only module without adding it to the ZIP-backed catalog first.
